name: friday-ng
description: Next-generation AI assistant with instant token streaming and multi-provider auto-setup (Pi Harness architecture)

scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true}); require('fs').rmSync('coverage', {recursive: true, force: true});"
scripts.start: npm run build && node --max-old-space-size=4096 dist/cli.js --provider kilo -i
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check && node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');if(!execSync('git rev-parse --verify HEAD').toString().trim())throw new Error('uncommitted changes');"
